title: NEON aquatic macroinvertebrate metabarcoding, RELEASE-2026: detection of 4,689 names (COI reads, two primer sets) per field sample at 34 NEON aquatic sites, 2018-2022
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Macroinvertebrate metabarcoding (DP1.20126.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/6n5z-z564. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.20126.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-12
abstract: NEON's benthic macroinvertebrate metabarcoding: in the midsummer bout each year, three benthic macroinvertebrate samples (Surber, Hess, core, kicknet, snag, sweep and large-woody-debris samplers by habitat) from wadeable streams, rivers and lakes are taken on one day beside the morphological samples, homogenised, and their DNA extracted and amplified with two COI primer sets (BE and F230); the laboratory (Jonah Ventures to 2021, Laragen in 2022) sequences the amplicons, denoises them into exact sequence variants, and assigns each variant a name by BLAST consensus against a BOLD COI reference. y = 1 when a name has reads in a sample for a primer set (any variant the laboratory reported, NEON's reporting threshold), else 0; y_raw is the read count, which is not abundance. One occasion per sample x primer set; sequencing depth (obs_reads_total, obs_reads_filtered), the number of variants and the best percent match ride on each row. The names surveyed for at a site are every name assigned there in any sample (median 284 of 4689; __survey_taxa). Coordinates are coarsened to the 0.1-degree cell because IUCN-threatened names are in the table; the _exact sibling has the other names at NEON's coordinates.
samplingProtocol: Three benthic macroinvertebrate DNA samples per site on one day in the midsummer bout (NEON AOS macroinvertebrate protocol NEON.DOC.003046, sampler by habitat); bulk DNA extraction, PCR with the COI primer sets BE and F230, Illumina MiSeq sequencing, DADA2 exact sequence variants, BLAST consensus naming against BOLD (NEON user guide NEON_INV_ZOO_DNA_userGuide_vG and laboratory SOPs)
surveyEvidenceNote: A survey is an extract x primer set with rows in inv_metabarcodeTaxonomy (the laboratory's bioinformatics output for it), from a field sample in inv_fieldData with samplingImpractical blank and a sequencing record NEON marks Pass. A 0 arises where such a survey reported no sequence variant assigned to a name of the site's pool. The pool is derived from detections (ruling 19; metabarcoding ruling of 2026-11-13): every name the laboratory assigned at the site in any sample by either primer set (__survey_taxa), not a list NEON deposited.
closureNote: occasion = field sample x primer set within one bout (samples taken on one day at the site; each primer set is a separate amplification and sequencing of the sample's extract); period = the sequenced (midsummer) bout, one a year per site, indexed globally by date
geographicCoverage: 34 NEON aquatic sites (wadeable streams, rivers, lakes) in the United States (contiguous states, Alaska, Puerto Rico); coordinates of the most recent sample's named location in __units (WGS 84); latitude 18.1 to 68.7, longitude -149.7 to -66.8

coordinatesCoarsened.method: coarsen_coords(): NEON's published coordinates in __units snapped to their 0.1-degree cell centre, uncertainty the cell half-diagonal, elevation rounded to 100 m, because names IUCN CR/EN/VU in their native range are in the table (Elimia bellacrenata (CR, at BLWA), Skistodiaptomus carolinensis (VU, at BLWA TOMB); E7, ruling on the publisher 2026-11-06). NEON site codes are kept. neon_2026_macroinverts_dna_exact_occ keeps the other names at published precision. Not a trigger: Africallagma quingentum (VU, BARC), Ceylonthelphusa cavatrix (EN, CUPE), Deronectes ferrugineus (VU, SUGG), Stygobromus indentatus (VU, KING), Stygobromus ozarkensis (VU, CARI), Stygobromus morrisoni (VU, CARI), Stygobromus hayi (EN, KING), assigned at sites far outside the species' native range (a related sequence, not the threatened species; E7(b) applies in the native range only).

covariateNote: obs_genetic_sample_id = NEON geneticSampleID (the morphological sampleID + '.DNA': join to the morphological product of the same sample); obs_marker = COI primer set (BE or F230); obs_reads_total and obs_reads_filtered = the sample x primer set's reads (sampleTotalReadNumber) and reads after quality filtering (sampleFilteredReadNumber) on the sequencing run its taxonomy comes from: the sequencing depth; obs_n_variants = the name's reported sequence variants in the survey (0 where y = 0); obs_max_pct_match = the highest percentSequenceMatch among them (NA where y = 0 or not reported), to apply a stricter identity threshold than the laboratory's; obs_lab = laboratory; obs_low_extraction_efficiency = 1 where NEON's dataQF reads 'low extraction efficiency' (every 2022 Laragen sample: an extraction that favoured bacterial DNA), else 0; obs_sampler_type, obs_habitat_type, obs_benthic_area_m2 = the sampler and habitat of the field sample and the benthic area it covered.
notes: Metabarcoding ruling (Ben, 2026-11-13; standard E9): detection, reads in y_raw, depth as obs_ columns; the read count is not abundance. NEON's reporting threshold is the laboratory's: a variant is reported only after denoising and filtering (smallest reported read count Jonah Ventures 8, Laragen 6). Names are the laboratory's assignments at whatever identity it reported (obs_max_pct_match ships it): 1849 species names, 1665 interim names (BOLD BINs and voucher labels, species-rank, no taxonID), 1092 at a higher rank. PCR replicates are not separable in the taxonomy table (reads are reported per extract x primer set), so they are not occasions; the 2022 sequencing records listed under replicates 1 and 2 are identical. Per-site pools (ruling 19): median 284 names (range 132-507). 2 extract(s) NEON marks extraction qaqc Fail are kept, since the laboratory reported taxonomy for them. The morphological counts of the companion samples are neon_2026_macroinverts_count (wadeable streams).

notShipped.unassigned sequence variants: 52,371 variant rows (4,418,175 reads) the laboratory did not name; their reads are in the depth columns, not in any row
notShipped.samples not sequenced: 957 field DNA samples with no extract in the release (bouts 1 and 3 are archived at the NEON Biorepository, not sequenced)
notShipped.surveys not used: 12 extract x primer sets of the 2017 pilot sequenced (four PCR replicates) with no taxonomy rows; 2 with no taxonomy rows after failed sequencing; 1 whose taxonomy comes from a sequencing record NEON marks Fail (fewer than 3,000 reads)
notShipped.sequences and raw data: taxonSequence (the variant's sequence), sequenceName, raw sequence files (expanded package links), the standard (mock community) samples, inv_metabarcodeTaxonList and inv_metabarcodeSummary
notShipped.zeros outside the site pool: a name never assigned at a site has no rows there (per-site pool)
